name: Agentic Career Counseling Companion
description: AI-powered personalized career guidance system using IBM Granite on WatsonX.ai. Multi-agent architecture with psychometric assessments, live market intelligence, and conversational AI counseling.
author: IBM University Engagement Program
features: Personalized career pathway recommendations using IBM Granite
Real-time labor market intelligence via JSearch API
Multi-turn AI chat counselor with conversation memory
Skills gap analysis for any target career
Mock mode for demo without IBM Cloud credentials

setup.backend: cd backend && py -3.12 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && py -3.12 main.py
setup.frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
